control_question: Can users understand the walking effort duration terrain language and limitations?
claim_rule: Do not publish vague accessible claim

control_question: Can the booking path be completed with keyboard zoom labels and clear errors?
claim_rule: Accessible design required regardless of EAA threshold

control_question: Can a guest request assistance without disclosing unnecessary diagnosis?
claim_rule: Ask functional need not medical history

control_question: Is the location identifiable reachable and free from ambiguous cycle or traffic conflict?
verification_method: Accompanied field audit at operating time

control_question: Are paving kerbs gradients and temporary plates manageable on every approved variant?
Are crossing times islands tram tracks and cycle flows safely manageable?
claim_rule: Guide must hold group and switch unsafe crossings

control_question: Can the route provide predictable rest without obstruction?
claim_rule: Publish realistic pace and rest availability

control_question: Is a reliable accessible toilet available during operating hours?
verification_method: Direct facility confirmation and field check
claim_rule: Never promise availability from map data alone

control_question: Can guests hear understand and request clarification without amplification?
verification_method: Pilot with hearing and language feedback
claim_rule: Offer concise written recap where useful

control_question: Are meeting instructions route changes and emergency messages available beyond visual-only cues?
Can a guest safely shorten leave or rejoin using accessible transport options?
verification_method: Field audit and live transit check

control_question: Are failed adjustments acknowledged remedied and used for improvement?
claim_rule: No blame; record outcome and corrective action
